overview.description: The Invesco RAFI US 1500 Small-Mid ETF (PRFZ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the RAFI Fundamental Select US 1500 index. The fund tracks a fundamentally-weighted index of 1,500 small- and mid-cap companies in the US that are selected using fundamental metrics. PRFZ was launched on Sep 20, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.
